parameters.text:
All of your issues, your parents explain, come from school. 

That is where Billie is, that is where you get ignored by people, that is where people know you as a victim of bullying. So the solution, of course, is to remove you from school! 

Clever, aren't they? 

Why solve the underlying issues when you can simply get rid of them completely? 

You nod your head to your parents, and you can practically see them metaphorically patting themselves on the back for a job well-done.
